title: auth: detectAuthGate does not recognise PASSWORD_RESET_REQUIRED, so a force-reset user gets a raw 403 instead of the change-password overlay once objectstack-ai/objectstack#23440 lands
body:
Filing gate ①, class (b): `reach:` is a named producer. objectstack-ai/objectstack#23440 (`Fixes` objectstack-ai/objectstack#23287, ruling C′) makes the backend answer an administrator-forced password change with `403 PASSWORD_RESET_REQUIRED` instead of reusing `PASSWORD_EXPIRED`.

Filed by objectstack `domain:spec` seat 4 (objectstack-ai/objectstack#18917) · `sunhaolin` · session `session_0121ooBYRmS8ziFXm9ai5YHm`, from the dev report `6165340573` on objectstack-ai/objectstack#23287 (out-of-scope finding 3), checked on objectui `origin/main`. ⛔ Not a claim. Lane, type and grade are objectui triage's.

## What happens

`packages/auth/src/auth-gate-events.ts` `detectAuthGate` raises the remediation event only for `MFA_REQUIRED` and `PASSWORD_EXPIRED` (the `code === 'MFA_REQUIRED' || code === 'PASSWORD_EXPIRED'` test), and `RemediationOverlay` routes `PASSWORD_EXPIRED` to the change-password form. After objectstack-ai/objectstack#23440 lands, a user whose administrator forced a password change gets `403 PASSWORD_RESET_REQUIRED` from protected endpoints, and no overlay opens: the user is stuck on raw 403s.

`Seam: spec:AuthGateCodeSchema (PASSWORD_RESET_REQUIRED) → runtime:plugin-auth AuthManager.resolveUserAuthGates | renderer:objectui packages/auth detectAuthGate / app-shell RemediationOverlay`

## What done looks like

- `detectAuthGate` accepts `PASSWORD_RESET_REQUIRED` and the overlay routes it to the change-password form, the way it routes `PASSWORD_EXPIRED`. The change is harmless before the backend emits the code.
- A pin: a `403 PASSWORD_RESET_REQUIRED` response raises the event, and the overlay shows the change-password form.

## Why it is first in line

objectstack seat 4 holds objectstack-ai/objectstack#23440's landing until objectstack's `.objectui-sha` pin carries this fix (the landing order the seat set on objectstack-ai/objectstack#23287). objectstack-ai/objectstack#23440 is p1, security. So this card is the wall in front of a p1 security landing.

**Reader who acts:** objectui triage routes it (the fix lands in `packages/auth`, so `domain:ui`, by the routing rule). The `domain:devx` pin hop that follows it is ordinary pin work.

## Dedupe

MCP `search_issues` on objectstack-ai/objectui, closed included: `detectAuthGate PASSWORD_RESET_REQUIRED remediation overlay change password forced reset console` → 2 hits: #2870 (closed: the overlay's i18n) and #2625 (closed: SSO button race). None is this.

Dedupe words: PASSWORD_RESET_REQUIRED console overlay; detectAuthGate remediation codes; forced reset remediation objectui.
